photos.title: Lotus Pillars
photos.alt: An open-air pavilion at night, its white pillars carved with lotus petals lit warm from below, red chairs and two people talking inside, framed by dark leaves.

photos.title: Kijk Je Naar Mij?
photos.alt: Black-and-white: two people take a photo of themselves in a scratched mirrored wall that reflects the Concertgebouw and people sitting on Museumplein; stickers read "Froukje, kijk je naar mij?"

photos.title: Rijksmuseum Passage
photos.alt: Black-and-white: the dark passage under the Rijksmuseum, its arched windows and iron gates framing a cyclist and crowds on the bright square beyond.

photos.title: Main Stage
photos.alt: Black-and-white: a beam of stage light falls through a gap in dark curtains onto a sign reading "Open House Main Stage".

photos.title: Rain Vortex
photos.alt: Black-and-white: a column of water pours down through the dark inside the Rain Vortex indoor waterfall, with blurred lights around it.

photos.title: Oasia Hotel Downtown
photos.alt: Black-and-white: looking up at the rounded tower of the Oasia Hotel Downtown, its facade covered in climbing plants, between shophouses and high-rises.

photos.title: #ClickHouse at Open House
photos.alt: A glowing teal #ClickHouse sign in front of an Open House backdrop, beside a carved stone statue of a goddess holding a stringed instrument.

photos.title: Backgammon
photos.alt: Black-and-white: an open backgammon board on a round wooden table, with cups blurred in the background.

photos.title: Never Stop Exploring
photos.alt: A street at night: a lit Never Stop Exploring sign on a stone wall above the pavement, with people walking past shop windows.

photos.title: LB's Record Bar
photos.alt: A window at night into a busy bar, with a red neon LB's Record Bar sign and people inside, set in a dark tiled wall.

photos.title: Wall of Playing Cards
photos.alt: Black-and-white: wooden shelves stacked with packs of playing cards, in shallow focus.

photos.title: Jester
photos.alt: Black-and-white: a grinning jester figure in a dim, crowded scene of fairy-tale characters.

photos.title: Fountain at Night
photos.alt: Black-and-white, at night: a spiky, castle-like fountain lit from below, rising out of dark water in front of trees.

photos.title: Chateau Under Star Trails
photos.alt: Looking up at a chateau's shuttered windows and pointed tower at night, with star trails and lit clouds streaking across the sky.

photos.title: Symbolica at Blue Hour
photos.alt: The ornate towers and domes of the Symbolica palace at blue hour, windows glowing, with an old street lamp in front.

photos.title: Portmeirion Sea Wall
photos.alt: Black-and-white long exposure: water pours from a sea wall onto a rocky shore, with a calm estuary, hills and a small tower behind.
